changes.text: Watched folders can add new screenshots straight to the mogi. Turn on Add Without Asking in Settings › Watched Folders.
Answering “Which race is this?” moves the screenshot to that race. It no longer shows under its old race too.
Adding a screenshot that's already in another mogi now says which mogi holds it and how to free it.
A mogi saved while a reopened room was misread numbers its races correctly again when you open it.
When the room reopens mid-mogi, its first results screen starts the new room, even if it was taken mid-animation.
